G59's reading 9, packet d3_pk_propose_0800 (T3-031 16, T3-033 to T3-043 36, T3-044 48), before its rows: (1) P20's statement names members who argue the canvas's worth, so T3-037's appraisals are held by P20: politics called vicious, a brigading sandbox, stupid amusement, an effort called garbage (Jamaica c0054, btc c0030, kcroyals c0113, borderlands c0019). (2) Held elsewhere: a member proposing a picture and asking to remove a swastika from the colour's work (P02: thetreesnetwork c0005, purplecorner c0033); a claim to a mark others made (P02: wine c0049); a neighbour's request to move accepted with its coordinates, and an objection to a neighbour building over the logo (P08: qotsa c0035, GuildWars2 c0162); a destroyed design given up for another (P10: kpop c0017); maintenance of other groups' works (P16: neopets c0066); an updated design link (P04: popheads c0277); a joke at a rival after the fight it planned (P18: wildhockey c0173); the sub's film lore in canvas talk (K04: prequelmemes c0346). (3) JOKE takes new jokes made of the work and its damage (parrots, placestart, rainbowgrid, ripcity, theexpanse, trees); RETURN takes T3-044's visitors drawn in by the mark or a sign, members asking whether the text brought anyone, welcoming, orienting and counting them (CryptoFR c0002, aoe2 c0213, livecounting c0045, nerf c0077), signs proposed to bring people in (eder c0013, placestart c0027); CHAT takes chats opened for a plan and their results brought back (battlecats c0170, riskofrain c0005, armok c0071); SPOT takes an emerging icon shifted from a guarded neighbour and a relocation after a failed plan (pebble c0043, muse c0052); COST takes a design left overnight for sleep and classes (wsu c0015). (4) Not shown: a bare number (anime_irl-071), a bare greeting (osu-060). Outside the scope: banter, a personal tattoo, a riff, shared fan art, a visitor clicking placers' names (purdue-029, rickandmorty-060, shitredditsays-054, twentyonepilots-059, futanari-054). One room: a threat to leave after criticism and stepping away from anger (funhaus-060, ockytop-057; two rooms, but a threat and a withdrawal are not one act), a lament at arriving after the close (bangladesh-060), paying for pixels (ethereum-041), tracking the wait (ufl-023), refusing an attack poster's collective we (apocalypserising-057). NONPORTABLE: counting-054, anime-044, counting-046, livecounting-040. Held for packet 1200 with T3-127 (seeking notice): Summit1G-044, TsundereSharks-029. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0800.txt

G59's reading 10, packet d3_pk_propose_0900 (T3-044 41, T3-045 to T3-052 59), before its rows: (1) A new candidate group, FAIR: members argue whether covering others' work is fair. Some call it betrayal; others answer that change is the canvas's point, that wiping makes room for future artists, or that the canvas was conquest and not drawing together (ik_ihe c0007, southpark c0042, theblackvoid c1446, PlaceNL c0211). A16 states only the refusal of an attack call with a reason, so worldpowers-027 (advertising over another group's work called scummy and a bad name for the sub, the attack's cost) is held by A16; the defence of covering and the argument after the act are stated by no element. (2) T3-044 joins RETURN, including counting subscribers and accounts, fixing a sign that sent viewers to the wrong sub, and members arguing how to receive the influx (tagpro c0010, c0119, parahumans c0179); rhythmheaven-010 is CHAT. (3) T3-045 is held by P08 (a spot or corner contested with a neighbour: Produce101 c0006, TreePlace c0006, bahrain c0042), and a mutual watch offered is P16 (Dustforce c0046). worldpowers-033 floods another sub over the drama, P18. alberta-049 is the provincial hockey rivalry, K03; anarcho_capitalism-050 and europe-067 are K04. ProfessorLayton-028 warns members not to provoke a neighbour, P07. (4) T3-052: members who ask and explain what a neighbouring figure is, or whose it is, join EXPLAIN (Redox c0003, haskell c0072, homestuck c0190); bare sightings and remarks on other rooms' pictures are talk about another room's work, which the stage file names outside the scope (eve c0137, kanye c0150, kuwait c0019). (5) Outside the scope: T3-048's game and platform April Fools events, a broadcast dispute and a recollection of an earlier event; T3-051's upvote pushes for joke posts with no tie to the canvas; a school choice using the picture (uiuc-055); a complaint about the sub that inspired a design (animalcrossing-042). crusaderkings-062 pushes the finished canvas image into search results, one room (particular); detroitlions-012 (held since packet 0100) boosts an r/nfl comment that gives the face's corner, a call to a kindred sub with the work's location, P01. JOKE takes a joke on the room's logo and a campus joke built on the final misspelling (CSUFoCo c0007, osu c0136); COST takes working alone all night to finish a sign (ss13 c0129). One room: quq-013 (the room declared an organization for the event), twice-013 (a call for better coordination). Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-0900.txt

G59's reading 11, packet d3_pk_propose_1000 (T3-052 16, T3-054 to T3-082 84), before its rows: (1) Two more candidate groups. SITE: members report what the site lets them do and work around it: a blank or stale canvas, the site down, a vanished or faulty timer, captchas on a later canvas, the site blocked in the country; they pass on fixes, refresh, update the app, keep a separate window (catalonia c0038, AvoArmy c0042, msu c0022, fxKorea c0015, catholicism c0137, furry_irl c0162, indonesia c0223, parrots c0030). SPITE: members who object to the canvas posts in the sub turn against the room's own mark: one blames the posts for making them tear down the logo, one recruits trolls to ruin the flag (nin c0116, philippines c0593); P20 states only the objection and the argument, not the damage. (2) COST takes members who cannot place from a phone or while travelling, who leave because the wait is too long, who save pixels by reusing colours under the timer, and who fit placing into finals (samuraijack c0045, PurplePixels c0125, wallstreetbets c0017, polandball c0145, simonfraser c0062). (3) P20 holds T3-063's removals and posting rules applied to canvas posts (ik_ihe c0015, tokyo c0008, vegan c0069, russia c0021, wholesomememes c0040, cubers c0073) and a sub arguing and locking a symbol made by a canvas alliance (partyparrot c0136); removals of April Fools posts and ordinary topic rules are the sub's own business (homelab, overwatch, leafs, wholesomememes-058), as is a stream chat's word ban (ice_poseidon-046). Held elsewhere: a removal for speaking as we (P21, ManningPlace c0012); a chat's plan repaired away until a member learns of it (P05's clause, Rainbow6 c0463); a war command dissolved and trials demanded (C01, indonesia c0205, c0218); hostile bots' names reported (P06, PurplePixels c0144); a script for erasing (P14, EraseThePlace c0184); the work moved to a later canvas (P13, ainbowroad c2053); neighbours listed around the finished art, the image kept as a background, and a build's fate recounted (P12: zootopia c0172, pcmasterrace c0774, ultrahardcore c0213); permission held against a move (P19, auburn c0035); kindred subs' chats and works (P17, anime c0116, marvel c0028); a phase called (P01, borderlands c0015); regret for damage (P07, udub c0019); a design posted and an objection to the flag mocked (P02, gameboy c0013, taiwan c0036); giving up (K02, gameattack c0017); the void's doctrine on sparing and help (K04, Thegreatblackhole c0075, c0066); a rival's word insisted on (P18, placehfarts c0008). (4) T3-052 remarks on other rooms' pictures are outside the scope; jokes made of a neighbour's picture join JOKE (poland c0113, patriots c0232). CHAT, RETURN, EXPLAIN and BORN take their lines as before (npr c0011, transformers c0022, oman c0015, placeportalpattern c0009, the new sub's theme). One room: a sub name taken from the lettering contested (quebec-066), spies put into a rival's chat (eve-037), fear of spoiling the work (sakuragakuin-051). Held for packet 1100 with T3-116: russia-031 (writing in code so that a rival cannot read the plan). Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-1000.txt

G59's reading 12, packet d3_pk_propose_1100 (T3-082 to T3-126, 100 lines), before its rows: (1) A new candidate group, HIDE: rooms keep their plans from rivals who read their threads and reach into rivals' venues. They switch to their own language or write in code, move the plan to private messages, and plant members in a rival's chat or warn of a snitch in their own (bakchodi c0121, lakers c0131, brasil c0382, anarcho_capitalism c0056); russia-031 (held from packet 1000) joins it, and eve-037 (spies in a rival's chat, ruled one room's in packet 1000) moves to it now that a second room shows the act. No element states concealment or infiltration. (2) CHAT now takes disputes over the chat as well as its use: whether a chat is needed or secure, which chat to use, whether it is official, whether it may decide for the work or bind placers, and a chat seized by a rival (archlinux c0141, Dustforce c0043, norge c0197, germany c0099, crusaderkings c0051, smashbros c0379, indieheads c0122); a room choosing the thread over a chat is the same choice (samuraijack c0282). (3) BORN takes a canvas room setting up and moving its venue, a part of a work becoming its own group, and repeaters gathered into a group so that they can negotiate (GreenEmpire c0002, Thegreatblackhole c0041, nVade c0002, placesnek c0100, rainbowgrid c0013). SITE takes glitches tested for extra pixels and a missing timer used (argentina c0457, furry_irl c0031, hellointernet c0049, scotland c0146). FAIR takes arguments over a joke put on a neighbour's flag and over whether breaking others' work is fun (eve c0268, rocketbeans c0132). (4) Held: P21 holds challenges to who speaks for a room toward others (Homura c0021, furry_irl c0172); P02 holds builders deciding a sign's words and a swastika replaced (DCFU c0012, austria c0080); C01 holds a self-crowned leader with offices and chat leaders ignoring a vote (PurplePixels c0130, theblackvoid c0578); P06 holds abusive placers and opponents reported (TheFarLeftSide c0238, orderofthebluecorner c0009); K03 holds the Taringa quarrel and the scaling dispute (argentina c0117, btc c0174); K04 holds the sub's flag lore (hellointernet c0016); P16 holds asking a room for help and turning an appeal away (redpandas c0023, egypt c0019); P19 holds whether art needs permission (twice c0128); P09 holds moving a displaced face onto a third group's area (ss13 c0110); P12 holds the end marked and the final image shared (uwaterloo c0133, muse c0151, OKState c0028, slovenia c0076); P20 holds canvas sub names reserved and the spam declared over (btc c0176, HomestarRunner c0140). (5) Outside the scope: T3-095, T3-097 and T3-100, the subs' own April Fools pranks, styling and requests to keep them; a petition against those who ended the canvas (pgang-053); a civility rule (homelab-032). One room: translating for helpers (epublica-005), hostility anticipated for the space taken (traaaaaaannnnnnnnnns-030), a ping questioned as from a compromised account (homelab-012), company kept while building (fxKorea-016), a pixel offered as thanks or for an upvote (france-058, pgang-052; with ethereum-041 three rooms trade a pixel, but a thank-you, a karma bargain and money are not one act and none shows the room organizing), a traitor joke (ufl-022), dual membership (iastate-028), a false moderator claim (paladins-045).
